title: SETA: Scaling Environments for Terminal Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.10891v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly shifting toward agents that solve tasks through diverse interfaces, including web and graphical user interfaces (GUIs). Among these, the terminal command line provides a text-based, general-purpose interface, covering tasks from system operations to data science and machine learning. However, scaling terminal-agent training remains challenging, as it requires diverse and coherent task instructions, executable environments, and reliable verification, while lacking naturally grounded supervision data. In this work, we propose SETA, a scalable framework for generating verifiable terminal environments for reinforcement learning (RL). The framework consists of two pipelines sharing a unified verification mechanism: SETA-Synth converts diverse sources into standardized RL environments, and SETA-Evol further expands from existing environments with adaptive control of difficulty and diversity. Togethe

translated_title: SETA：面向终端智能体的可扩展环境
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）正迅速转向通过多样化界面解决任务的智能体，包括网页和图形用户界面（GUI）。在这些界面中，终端命令行提供了一种基于文本的通用界面，涵盖从系统操作到数据科学和机器学习的各类任务。然而，扩展终端智能体的训练仍然具有挑战性，因为它需要多样且连贯的任务指令、可执行的环境以及可靠的验证机制，同时缺乏有自然依据的监督数据。在这项工作中，我们提出了SETA，一个用于生成可验证终端环境的可扩展强化学习（RL）框架。该框架由共享统一验证机制的两条流水线组成：SETA-Synth将多样化数据源转换为标准化的RL环境，SETA-Evol则在现有环境基础上进一步扩展，并对难度和多样性进行自适应控制。两者共同……
tldr: SETA提出了一个可扩展的强化学习框架，通过共享统一验证机制的SETA-Synth和SETA-Evol两条流水线，自动生成可验证、难度与多样性可控的终端环境，以支持终端智能体的训练。
en_tdlr: SETA is a scalable RL framework that generates verifiable terminal environments for training terminal agents through two pipelines—SETA-Synth and SETA-Evol—which share a unified verification mechanism and adaptively control task difficulty and diversity.
